description: Human-readable names for the console (P Part 6 X10, M6-06). Display text only: never a reading, limit or engine value. Channel keys use {n} for the cylinder number in both forms the system uses (cht[1] in readings, cht_1 in residuals). Component ids not listed here are shown humanized (oil_filter -> Oil filter, injector_3 -> Injector 3).

components.main_engine_MERGED: Engine (one merged part in this 3D model)
components.wastegate_MISSEGMENTED: Turbo and wastegate area (parts not separated in this 3D model)

GO.title: Engine healthy
GO.text: All readings are inside their limits and no fault is suspected.

ADVISORY.title: Advisory
ADVISORY.text: Something needs attention, but the mission can continue. The reasons are listed below.

CAUTION.title: Caution
CAUTION.text: A reading or a suspected fault needs action soon. Follow the actions listed below.

NO-GO.title: No-go
NO-GO.text: Do not continue the mission on this engine: a limit is exceeded or a serious fault is likely. Follow the actions listed below.

UNKNOWN.title: Waiting for data
UNKNOWN.text: No status yet: the engine is still calibrating or the connection is down.
